title: Scalar-POI tilt-DP gives a valid two-sided certificate with an exact saddle closure gate
statement: For d_psi=1 and positive finite weights, write V_z(beta)=btw(S_psi-beta S_lambda;z) (uncentered), v_K(beta)=max_z V_z(beta), and Phi^+(z)=min_beta V_z(beta). The DP-active generalized primal p^+, generalized global value g^+, regular in-bin primal p_reg, regular global value g_reg, and dual d=min_beta v_K(beta) obey p^+ <= g^+ <= d and p_reg <= g_reg <= g^+ <= d; d is attained after quotienting the common nuisance-null space. The generalized bracket closes, p^+=g^+=d, iff some labeling z in the DP-optimal set D(beta) at some beta satisfies beta I_lambdalambda(z)=I_psilambda(z); then every Phi^+-maximiser and every dual minimiser form such a pair; if the exhibited z has a nonsingular nuisance block it is an ordinary in-bin global optimum, otherwise it certifies only the DS11 pseudo-inverse problem. Fixed-tilt exact rational evaluation of v_K, an active labeling, the exact one-sided derivatives and the primal values costs O(KN^2) rational operations (O(KN) after sorting) and tolerates exact ties in every tie order (tie lemma). A certified rational epsilon-bracket on d is computable in time polynomial in the input bits and log(1/epsilon) via an observable coercivity radius, a subgradient separation oracle and a cutting-plane LP lower certificate. Exact minimisation is polynomial in bit complexity at d_lambda=1 for every K (root-separation bisection on the one-sided DP derivatives, output rational or a degree-2 algebraic number), and polynomial in arithmetic operations for fixed d_lambda>=2 and variable K (Toledo 1993 parametric search). Exact polynomial bit complexity for fixed d_lambda>=2 with variable K, and any exact statement for variable d_lambda, is OPEN-DS-TILT-DUAL-EXACT-COMPLEXITY.
assumptions: d_psi=1; d_lambda>=1; finite score table; strictly positive rational weights (a zero-weight row in its own cell makes V_z undefined and is excluded; a zero-weight row sharing a cell is inert); exactly K nonempty cells with N>=K
all empirical second moments are about the score-space origin; no sample centering is performed
the generalized domain uses DS11's Moore-Penrose value; the ordinary in-bin domain separately requires a nonsingular binned nuisance block; a singular DP state is a generalized lower bound only

the comparison domain (collapsed duplicate atoms or unrestricted rows) is named: D(beta) and g^+ are domain-dependent; the tie lemma makes the dual v_K identical on both domains whenever K does not exceed the atom count

the closure gate is set-valued: certification requires exhibiting a concrete DP-optimal labeling whose normal equation holds; a deterministic tie policy may return a non-closing member of D(beta*) when the bracket closes (CE-DS-TILT-DUAL-TIE-MASK-001), so a reported open interval [Phi^+(z_DP), d] is not evidence of a duality gap

polynomial certified-accuracy optimization assumes rational input and a requested rational epsilon and uses a polynomial-bit box radius from singleton-versus-rest partitions, the ellipsoid/GLS rounding discipline, and an exact LP over the collected cuts as the lower certificate

exact minimisation at d_lambda=1 returns an exact rational or quadratic-irrational tilt certified by D-(beta*)<=0<=D+(beta*); the fixed-d_lambda>=2 statement is arithmetic complexity from Toledo 1993, not a bit bound

proof_location.section: DS19. The tilt-DP bracket: weak certification, an order-one gap, and a value-consistent DS18 primal

warning: Audited 2 Sep 2026 (AUDIT-DS-PRACTICAL-CERTIFIED-SOLVER): verified with hardened assumptions. The dual is a ceiling on both domains, but a singular DP state is not an in-bin lower bound. Strong duality is false by CE-DS-TILT-DUAL-GAP-001 and, support-minimally, CE-DS-TILT-DUAL-GAP-002. A reported open bracket is not a gap certificate (CE-DS-TILT-DUAL-TIE-MASK-001). The primal side p^+ can sit strictly below g^+. Crossings-plus-midpoints and epsilon-accurate convex optimization are not exact algebraic solvers. Verification authorizes no src change; compilation remains governed by DS-PROFILED-COMPILE-CERTIFICATE.
